'''Degan Explorations''' was a subsidiary of [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]].<ref name="HSCS" /> They explored new [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] for their chemical resources. It also produced [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]]. They were notable for possessing a vast network of [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]-based [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and survey crews whose purpose was to find new chemical sources.<ref name="EtU">''[[Enter the Unknown]]''</ref>
